J12 — Conn_01x02 (illustrated: power_screw_terminal_round)
XT30 power connector (2-pole)
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.

Field: +24 V → contact → J1.1; isolated 0 V → J1.2
SJ1 OPEN · J1.3 and TP5 OPEN · no ground bridge
SOURCE STUDY · verify installed hardware and firmware · read limits

ns0:g.data-plane: above-PCB plug interior; physical fit unknown

ns0:svg.ns0:text: PROPOSED TOP-ENTRY PLUG · unpowered source study; mating and physical clearance unknown.
Coloured plug paths are above-PCB interior projections. Grey jacket carries three insulated cores.
Eight exact decorative rail crossings are recorded; no foreign native pad or component exemption.
